title: Simulation Run Trace
description: The event trace of one replication of a simulation run: for each station, every interval it spent busy, blocked, starved, down or in setup, as a start and an end in seconds from the start of the run. It is what a layout view or an animation replays and what a station's shares in the run's results are summed from. A run states its results; its trace states how they arose.

runRef.description: The simulation-run this trace is one replication of.

replication.description: Which of the run's replications, counting from 1.

uom.description: The unit of every start, end, warm-up end and horizon: seconds (UN/CEFACT SEC) from the start of the run, warm-up included.

horizon.description: When the trace ends. No interval ends after it.

warmUpEnd.description: When the warm-up the run's results exclude ends.

stationRef.description: The equipment record of the station.

intervals.description: In order of start. A station is in one state at a time, so intervals do not overlap; a time no interval covers is idle.

state.description: busy, working a unit; blocked, holding a finished unit the next buffer cannot take; starved, waiting for a unit; down, failed or under repair; setup, changing over (after VDI 3633 and ISO 22400-2).

unitRef.description: The unit or lot worked, where the run tracks one.
